Head_and_Face: Broad flattened head with short snout.
Body_and_Plumage: Elongated streamlined body measuring 60-120 cm body length weighing 5-15 kg.
Dense dark brown waterproof fur with lighter ventral coloration.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Short legs with webbed feet and sharp claws.
Long thick muscular tail tapering to point.

Body_and_Plumage: Stocky body measuring 40-70 cm body length weighing 1-5 kg.
Black fur with distinctive white stripes or spots forming bold warning pattern.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Short legs.
Long bushy tail.
Anal glands produce intensely malodorous fluid ejected as spray when startled, accurate to 3 m range.

Head_and_Face: Broad flattened head with pointed snout.
Distinctive black and white facial stripes.
Body_and_Plumage: Low-slung robust body measuring 55-90 cm body length weighing 7-17 kg.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Short powerful legs with broad feet and long non-retractile claws adapted for digging.
Short bushy tail.

Head_and_Face: Small head with pointed snout and conical teeth.
Body_and_Plumage: Body measuring 35-75 cm body length weighing 2-30 kg.
Body covered with strong horny plates (osteoderms) forming protective armor over leathery skin.
Some species can roll into ball.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Short legs with powerful claws for digging.
Tail armored with bony rings.

Head_and_Face: Small rounded head with short snout.
Small eyes with dark facial markings.
Body_and_Plumage: Body measuring 45-65 cm body length weighing 3.5-5 kg.
Long coarse fur in gray-brown with greenish tint from symbiotic algae.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Forefeet with three long curved claws for hanging from branches.
Hind feet also three-clawed.
Vestigial tail.

Head_and_Face: Broad flat face with prominent cheek pads in mature males.
Dark brown eyes with forward-facing binocular vision.
Body_and_Plumage: Large body measuring 120-150 cm standing height weighing 35-90 kg.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Extremely long arms (wingspan 2 m) adapted for brachiation.
Long-fingered hands with opposable thumbs and big toes.

Head_and_Face: Large head with prominent sagittal crest in males.
Black face with small eyes and broad nose.
Mature males develop silver saddle of gray hair on back.
Body_and_Plumage: Massive body measuring 150-180 cm standing height weighing 100-200 kg.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Arms longer than legs with broad hands.
Knuckle-walking locomotion.

Head_and_Face: Bare face light to dark with prominent ears.
Body_and_Plumage: Body measuring 70-100 cm standing height weighing 30-60 kg.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Arms longer than legs with long fingers.
Hands with opposable thumbs.

Head_and_Face: Bare dark face with prominent brow ridges.
Body_and_Plumage: Body measuring 60-90 cm standing height weighing 4-10 kg.
Dense fur in black, brown, white, or buff coloration.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Exceptionally long arms (nearly twice body length) adapted for brachiation.
Long-fingered hands with hook-like grip.

Head_and_Face: Bare black face with prominent throat sac (gular sac) used for vocalization.
Body_and_Plumage: Large body measuring 80-100 cm standing height weighing 10-14 kg.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Extremely long arms adapted for brachiation.
Long-fingered hands.
Second and third toes partially united by web (syndactyly).
